unit: TREATMENT_RUN = frozen task x frozen treatment x frozen executor binding x frozen shaping x rollout/repetition
failure_cost_rule: all consumed resources remain accounted for on failure or inconclusive
free_local_rule: FREE != ZERO COST; keep hardware, energy, setup, maintenance, verification and escalation separate; no hardware-to-token conversion
cache_rule: record cache availability, creation, amortization and matched cache state; cache benefit is not free
price_drift_rule: retain historical source/date; future-price normalization is separate analysis
